name: Minato Mimi
source:
Childhood friend of Akihito, Mimi is also a pretty serious character who’s quiet and calm. Most of the time. As she sticks to Akihito quite a lot, everyone thought that they’re dating, but Mimi is pretty shy so it’s not true.
